summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K on May 30, 2026, announcing a non-binding term sheet with Helmex Global LLP for a potential $2.0 billion structured financing across four tranches of up to $500M each. The company will issue shares at $1.55-$2.00 per share to the counterparty in exchange for preferred units in an investment vehicle. Datavault must pay a non-refundable $25M fee by June 4, 2026, plus $25M per additional tranche. Completion requires due diligence, definitive agreements, stockholder approval, regulatory/CFIUS clearance, a charter amendment, fairness opinion, and independent valuation. The counterparty may nominate one director per tranche. Watch for definitive agreement execution and regulatory hurdles; the fee structure raises governance and dilution concerns.
